answer: Reputation decay. Every identity starts at 100 points. After 2 idle epochs it loses 8 points per epoch. Below 60, rewards stop. Verification restores 6 points, capped at 100. Copying drops the score to 20 and freezes it 6 epochs. Idle clones pay the same jetty tax as active ones. The karst audit mirrors score history. Keeping 1,000 clones honest costs 3,000 units per epoch. One skipped cycle loses 8,000 points fleet-wide. Break-even is 3 units per epoch per clone, or it bleeds. A 30% detection rate adds 50% slashes. Hoarding pays only if every clone works every epoch.
